name: cp-v11
idea_origin: Comprobante line, 29 Oct: token accounting of the real DeepSeek traces (history grows ~608 tokens per model call, 431 of them tool results and framing; total tokens are quadratic in the number of model calls) plus the pending candidates c5 (quality), t0 (Skill from level 4), suelo-v1-min (stalled start, size of the risk) and v4-lean-q (one observe per quarter; Leah's branch leah/workspace, not a registered parent)
operator: cp-v10 + quarterly fixes from the second cp-v10 game and the replica
hypothesis: Output reaches each bar earlier at levels 1-3 (quarter = report, network, report, key project, as v4 did; no Skill learning while Skill fills from stories), and a blow-up no longer freezes growth for the rest of the run (Defuse every quarter, main action normal).
predicted_behaviour: Replica over cp-v10 rules: +0.4 exact / +1.0 noisy for the level-1 Output quarter; lockdef equal or better in both readings (60.33/42.08 vs 60.27/41.91), full lockdown costs L6 and 4 Skill. In games: Prepare report materials in every level 1-3 quarter; after a blow-up, Defuse plus a normal main action.
refutation: A level 1-3 quarter with Skill learning, or Lay low every quarter after a blow-up with the friendly remark, or a judge drop of more than 5 against cp-v10.
change: cp-v10 plus: (1) quarterly line 7 for levels 1-3 fixed to v4's order (Prepare report materials, Network maintenance, Prepare report materials; main action Apply for a key project; no Skill learning), because in cp-v10's second game DeepSeek bought Skill learning at level 3 with Skill at its best for 12 months while Output stayed at 8-11 and the level-4 bar needed 14, and v4's games reached the Output best at every level; (2) the post-blow-up rule reduced to Defuse legacy risk every quarter with a normal main action (the full lockdown made every quarter Defuse + Lay low for 24 months in that game; replica: full lockdown -4 Skill and L6 25 -> 21 %, Defuse-only equal or better in both readings). Evidence for (1) also in the 14-game table of the first six months (Output is the last stat to reach the first bar).
